text:
maria: FYI rolled keystore audit retention in eu-west to 180d late last night as per compliance request. seeing failures in warm-pool onboarding this morning.

ops-bot: [ALERT] keystore-proxy-euw: 503 x95 in 15m; privatelink-euw conntrack_slab_full. Trigger: warm-pool-join-failures (n=31).

alex: Can someone paste the error lines from the failing node(s)? want to confirm conntrack vs keystore latency.

maria: snippet from node-78: 
```
2026-03-22T03:12:04Z keystore-proxy euw3 503 "upstream timeout"
2026-03-22T03:12:05Z kubelet euw3 pod/warmup-78 CrashLoopBackOff -> keystore timeout
kernel: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
```

jess: Looks like conntrack overflow at the NAT level combined with increased audit export QPS from the keystore. Short-term we can either bump nf_conntrack_max or throttle keystore audit exporter.

kevin: quick cost check: 180d retention in euw adds ~+$8k/mo (storage + export). If we drop index retention to 60d for keystore-audit only, extra cost drops to ~$2k/mo. Security might not like rollback without approval.

alex: propose mitigation runbook: 1) targeted retention rollback for keystore-audit index to 60d (service-scoped) as canary; 2) temporarily double nf_conntrack_max on euw NATs for 6h; 3) observe warm-pool join rate for 30m; 4) if stable, plan infra rate-limits/batching for exporter.

jess: commands to run on NAT nodes (one-off):
```
sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144
cat /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_count
# monitor conntrack hits
watch -n 5 'ss -s | grep conntrack'
```

maria: I'll create a compliance exception ticket and @security for a scoped approval. We need the rollback documented and re-audited after.

kevin: please add the monthly cost delta and the plan for permanent mitigation in the ticket. if security insists on 180d, we need infra changes (exporter rate-limit, batching, or move to async export via SQS).

alex: jess, can you start the NAT bump and report conntrack_count before/after? i'll prep the rollback patch for keystore policy in infra-admin. If >95% successful joins in 30m we close this thread.

jess: NAT bump started. initial conntrack_count=189732. will post updates in ~5m. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: [INFO] compliance exception ticket #INC-7421 created (retention-canary). awaiting security approval.

maria: also flagging regional fallback: if euw3 remains unstable we'll divert new GPU allocations to eu-central for next 24-48h. not ideal but reduces blast radius.

jess: 5m update: conntrack_count=192010 (still rising), nf_conntrack_max now 262144. observed keystore-proxy 503s dropping by ~60% in the last 3m.

alex: starting retention rollback for keystore-audit index (keystore service only). will push change via infra-admin and mark as emergency canary.

maria: pinged @security for approval thread with ticket link. prepping postmortem template.

kevin: note for postmortem: include cost comparison matrix for 60/90/180d retention and infra ops cost to permanently mitigate.

jess: 20m update: conntrack count stabilizing ~194k, 503s down to baseline, warm-pool join success improving (from 22% -> 88%).

alex: can we hold for 30m and then decide? if stable, roll to 90d while working on exporter rate-limits.

maria: agreed. i'll keep this thread for short updates. if we need BLAM or PagerDuty escalation i'll open incidents/.. channel.

ops-bot: [RESOLVE] auto-alert suppressed after remediation window. remember to follow up with security and ops for permanent fix.

alex: thanks. action items: (maria) compliance ticket + security approval, (jess) schedule exporter rate-limit spike test, (kevin) cost model in ticket, (alex) create infra task for batching exporter.

maria: will do. closing this check-in in 30m unless new failures show up.
